metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Remaining Properties Checklist (Batch 3)
metadata.description: Partial audit checklist for non-boundary properties (PROP-041 to PROP-060). This batch covers Hub contract operations, aggregation root broadcasting, Indexer service operations, and Prover/Decider service operations.

checklist.title: Verify Hub stores validated roots with monotonic tree index to prevent rollback attacks
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Hub contract's _lzReceive() or root update handler function
2. Verify transferRoots[tokenIndex] mapping stores roots by token index
3. Check that tree index is monotonically increasing
4. Verify no path allows overwriting a valid root with an older index
5. Check for reentrancy protections during root update
6. Verify event TransferRootUpdated is emitted with correct parameters

executable_checks.assertion: Root updates must increase tree index; rollback attempts must revert
No reentrancy vulnerabilities in root update path
TransferRootUpdated event emitted with correct token and root data

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-041-HUB-UPDATE-TRANSFER-ROOT -> Node ACTION-HUB-UPDATE-TRANSFER-ROOT. Per-token root tracking with monotonic indices prevents state rollback attacks.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-UPDATED is only reachable after valid EID validation
detection_procedure: 1. Trace all paths leading to STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-UPDATED in Hub contract
2. Verify EID validation occurs in _lzReceive before root storage
3. Check that unauthorized source EIDs cause message rejection
4. Verify no alternative paths bypass EID validation
5. Check TransferRootUpdated event is emitted only after successful validation

executable_checks.assertion: Messages from unregistered Verifier EIDs must revert
All paths to root storage pass through EID validation
Only registered Verifier peers can trigger root updates

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-042-TRANSFER-ROOT-UPDATED -> Node STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-UPDATED. EID validation is mandatory before reaching this intermediate state.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-AWAITING-BROADCAST holds current roots and broadcast reads latest state
detection_procedure: 1. Locate broadcast() function in Hub contract
2. Verify broadcast reads current transferRoots state at call time
3. Check that all prior root updates are included in aggregation
4. Verify no race condition between root updates and broadcast
5. Check for proper synchronization if concurrent updates are possible

executable_checks.assertion: Broadcast aggregation includes all roots updated before broadcast call
Broadcast operation is atomic and consistent

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-043-AWAITING-BROADCAST -> Node STATE-AWAITING-BROADCAST. Batch aggregation waiting state ensures all pending roots are included.

checklist.title: Verify Hub computes PoseidonT3 aggregation tree correctly over token roots
detection_procedure: 1. Locate aggregation root computation in Hub contract
2. Verify PoseidonT3 hash function usage matches circom configuration
3. Check tree height of 6 supports max 64 tokens correctly
4. Verify deterministic computation (same inputs → same root)
5. Compare on-chain computation with reference circom implementation
6. Check padding scheme for unregistered tokens

executable_checks.assertion: Same token roots always produce identical aggregation root
On-chain PoseidonT3 matches circom reference implementation
Aggregation tree correctly handles up to 64 token roots

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-044-HUB-COMPUTE-AGGREGATION -> Node ACTION-HUB-COMPUTE-AGGREGATION. PoseidonT3 configuration must match circuit constraints for proof verification.

checklist.title: Verify aggSeq counter increments monotonically to prevent replay attacks
detection_procedure: 1. Locate aggSeq counter in Hub contract storage
2. Verify aggSeq increments on every broadcast() call
3. Check no path allows decrementing or resetting aggSeq
4. Verify overflow protection (if applicable)
5. Check aggSeq is included in broadcast message payload

executable_checks.assertion: aggSeq only increases; never decreases or resets
No unauthorized modification paths for aggSeq
Each broadcast call increments aggSeq by exactly 1

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-045-HUB-INCREMENT-AGG-SEQ -> Node ACTION-HUB-INCREMENT-AGG-SEQ. Sequence number provides ordering guarantee and prevents replay of old global roots.

checklist.title: Verify Hub broadcasts aggregation root to all registered Verifiers via LayerZero
detection_procedure: 1. Locate broadcast() function in Hub contract
2. Verify iteration over all registered Verifier endpoints
3. Check _lzSend is called for each registered endpoint
4. Verify error handling for failed sends doesn't stop iteration
5. Check LayerZero message options and gas limits
6. Verify broadcast emits events for monitoring

executable_checks.assertion: Broadcast sends message to every registered Verifier endpoint
Single endpoint failure does not abort broadcast to remaining endpoints
Verify _lzSend call flow covers all registered peers

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-046-HUB-BROADCAST-ROOT -> Node ACTION-HUB-BROADCAST-ROOT. External dependency on LayerZero multicast; REACHABLE_BUT_MITIGATED by retry mechanisms.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-BROADCAST indicates all LayerZero sends were initiated
detection_procedure: 1. Verify state transition occurs only after all _lzSend calls complete
2. Check GlobalRootBroadcast event is emitted with correct aggSeq and root
3. Verify event emission is atomic with state transition
4. Check for proper error handling if any send fails

executable_checks.assertion: GlobalRootBroadcast event emitted after all sends complete
Event contains correct aggregation root and sequence number

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-047-GLOBAL-ROOT-BROADCAST -> Node STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-BROADCAST. Hub-side broadcast completion state for monitoring.

checklist.title: Verify Verifier validates source EID is authorized Hub before storing global root
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Verifier contract's _lzReceive() handler
2. Verify source EID validation against hubEid
3. Check messages from non-Hub endpoints are rejected
4. Verify no alternative path to store global roots bypasses validation
5. Check globalTransferRoots mapping update is protected
6. Verify GlobalRootSaved event emission

executable_checks.assertion: Messages from non-Hub EIDs must be rejected
Only messages from authorized Hub EID can update global roots
hubEid is validated and non-zero

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-048-VERIFIER-SAVE-GLOBAL-ROOT -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-SAVE-GLOBAL-ROOT. CRITICAL: Prevents global root injection attacks that enable fake cross-chain teleports.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED is only reachable via authorized Hub messages
detection_procedure: 1. Trace all paths to globalTransferRoots storage write
2. Verify all paths require Hub EID validation
3. Check for admin functions that might bypass validation
4. Verify GlobalRootSaved event correlates with storage update
5. Check no initializer or upgrade path bypasses validation

executable_checks.assertion: All paths to global root storage require Hub EID validation
Verify access control on all global root modification functions

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-049-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED -> Node STATE-GLOBAL-ROOT-SAVED. Terminal state for global root reception; enables cross-chain teleport verification.

checklist.title: Verify Indexer service follows blockchain events deterministically
detection_procedure: 1. Review Indexer service initialization and configuration
2. Verify service connects to correct RPC endpoints
3. Check service state management and recovery procedures
4. Verify health check endpoints expose proper status
5. Review logging and monitoring for operational visibility

executable_checks.assertion: Indexer health endpoint reports ready state correctly
Indexer configuration validates against expected schema

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-050-INDEXER-IDLE -> Node STATE-INDEXER-IDLE. Semi-trusted service; proofs are verified on-chain so misconfiguration impacts liveness, not security.

checklist.title: Verify Indexer subscribes to IndexedTransfer events from correct zERC20 contract
detection_procedure: 1. Review Indexer event subscription configuration
2. Verify zERC20 contract address is correctly configured
3. Check event filter matches IndexedTransfer event signature
4. Verify no events from other contracts are processed
5. Check address validation on incoming events

executable_checks.assertion: Indexer only processes events from configured zERC20 address
Events from non-configured addresses are ignored

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-051-INDEXER-WATCH-EVENTS -> Node ACTION-INDEXER-WATCH-EVENTS. REACHABLE_BUT_MITIGATED: Fake events produce invalid proofs that fail on-chain verification.

checklist.title: Verify Indexer constructs Merkle tree from events in correct order
detection_procedure: 1. Review Merkle tree construction logic in Indexer
2. Verify events are processed in correct block/log order
3. Check tree construction matches on-chain hash chain order
4. Verify Poseidon hash configuration matches contracts
5. Compare constructed root against on-chain root

executable_checks.assertion: Tree construction follows event emission order
Constructed Merkle root matches on-chain transferRoot
Indexer Poseidon implementation matches contract implementation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-052-INDEXER-BUILD-TREE -> Node ACTION-INDEXER-BUILD-TREE. REACHABLE_BUT_MITIGATED: Incorrect tree produces proofs that fail on-chain verification.

checklist.title: Verify Indexer tree synchronization status reflects actual on-chain state
detection_procedure: 1. Review tree synchronization status tracking logic
2. Verify synchronization status updates on new events
3. Check stale detection and recovery mechanisms
4. Verify API correctly reports synchronization status
5. Check handling of chain reorganizations

executable_checks.assertion: Tree ready status accurately reflects synchronization state
Indexer correctly handles chain reorganizations

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-053-INDEXER-TREE-READY -> Node STATE-INDEXER-TREE-READY. Liveness concern; stale proofs fail verification but don't compromise security.

checklist.title: Verify Indexer generates valid Merkle inclusion proofs
detection_procedure: 1. Review Merkle proof generation algorithm
2. Verify proof format matches on-chain verification expectations
3. Test generated proofs against on-chain verifier
4. Check sibling ordering and path encoding
5. Verify proof generation handles edge cases (first/last leaf)

executable_checks.assertion: Generated proofs verify successfully on-chain
Indexer-generated proofs pass contract verification
Proof generation handles boundary leaves correctly

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-054-INDEXER-GENERATE-PROOFS -> Node ACTION-INDEXER-GENERATE-PROOFS. Merkle proof generation is deterministic; correctness depends on tree synchronization.

checklist.title: Verify Prover service handles malformed inputs without security impact
detection_procedure: 1. Review Prover service API input validation
2. Verify malformed inputs are rejected early
3. Check service doesn't crash on invalid inputs
4. Verify rate limiting and resource protection
5. Review error handling and logging

executable_checks.assertion: Malformed IVC proofs are rejected with appropriate error
Service enforces resource limits and rate limiting

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-055-PROVER-IDLE -> Node STATE-PROVER-IDLE. REACHABLE_BUT_MITIGATED: Invalid outputs fail on-chain Groth16 verification.

checklist.title: Verify Prover validates and deserializes Nova IVC proofs before processing
detection_procedure: 1. Review IVC proof deserialization logic
2. Verify proof structure validation before processing
3. Check local IVC verification before Groth16 conversion
4. Verify deserialization doesn't cause resource exhaustion
5. Check error handling for invalid proof formats

executable_checks.assertion: Invalid proof formats are rejected during deserialization
Local IVC verification catches invalid proofs before conversion
IVC validation rejects malformed proofs

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-056-PROVER-RECEIVE-IVC -> Node ACTION-PROVER-RECEIVE-IVC. Input validation protects service resources and prevents wasted computation.

checklist.title: Verify job queue persistence and recovery for proof conversion jobs
detection_procedure: 1. Review job queue implementation and persistence
2. Verify job state is persisted before acknowledgment
3. Check job recovery mechanisms on service restart
4. Verify queue ordering (FIFO or priority-based)
5. Check job timeout and retry mechanisms

executable_checks.assertion: Queued jobs survive service restart
Jobs are recovered and processed after service recovery

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-057-JOB-QUEUED -> Node STATE-JOB-QUEUED. REACHABLE_BUT_MITIGATED: Job loss requires user resubmission but doesn't affect security.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-JOB-PROCESSING is only reachable from valid queued jobs
detection_procedure: 1. Review job state machine transitions
2. Verify processing state requires prior queued state
3. Check no path bypasses queue to reach processing
4. Verify concurrent processing limits
5. Check job state transition logging

executable_checks.assertion: Job transitions follow QUEUED -> PROCESSING -> COMPLETED/FAILED
Concurrent processing respects configured limits

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-058-JOB-PROCESSING -> Node STATE-JOB-PROCESSING. Intermediate processing state; no security impact from state machine violations.

checklist.title: Verify Nova IVC to Groth16 conversion maintains cryptographic soundness
detection_procedure: 1. Review Groth16 circuit and witness generation from IVC accumulator
2. Verify converted proof uses correct verification key
3. Check public inputs are preserved correctly
4. Verify Groth16 proof passes on-chain verification
5. Test conversion with known valid/invalid IVC proofs

executable_checks.assertion: Groth16 conversion produces valid proofs from valid IVC proofs
Converted Groth16 proofs verify on-chain
Public inputs are correctly preserved through conversion

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-059-PROVER-CONVERT-TO-GROTH16 -> Node ACTION-PROVER-CONVERT-TO-GROTH16. CRITICAL: Cryptographic core of proof conversion; mathematical soundness ensures validity.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-JOB-COMPLETED indicates valid Groth16 proof is available for retrieval
detection_procedure: 1. Verify completion state is set only after successful proof generation
2. Check proof is persisted before completion state transition
3. Verify proof retrieval API returns the generated proof
4. Check completion includes proof validity verification
5. Verify cleanup of intermediate processing artifacts

executable_checks.assertion: Completed jobs have retrievable valid proofs
Proof is persisted before completion state is set
Retrieved proofs from completed jobs verify on-chain

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-060-JOB-COMPLETED -> Node STATE-JOB-COMPLETED. Terminal success state; proof availability is service implementation concern.
